Existing faction, Realm, Gate, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; Ascension now centers that restored divine power inside Torii-Moon Mirror Road, where one selected god or goddess crosses The Torii-Moon Gate against many enemies, route hazards, Hollow pressure, elite locks, and a boss chamber.
